states: Real SSO settings UI on Chromium 141.0.7390.37 and Playwright 1.56.1 with synthetic API responses: delayed matching detail, saved secret reported with inventory marker omitted, and no secret reported despite inventory marker.

Opened and compared 16 before/after images, including both focused fields after scrolling to them on the dark touch viewport. The empty field now has persistent, matching guidance above it; the registration and access context, redirect and scopes fields, and footer actions keep their positions in the paired states.
Add OIDC retains its PKCE hint, SAML editing retains its fields, and read-only operators retain the management restriction.
interactions: 274 main assertions and 68 scrolled phone assertions. Open each saved editor, verify the named password field and its description, type a synthetic draft without losing the hint, and check keyboard order, touch focus and the callback copy control.

Save a display-name-only edit with the password field untouched: the same provider receives one synthetic PUT omitting the blank client secret and the read-only marker. No provider sign-in or live request.
